text: With a thrilling 2-1 victory in extra time against Germany, the Lionesses were crowned champions of UEFA Women's Euro 2022, securing their first major title before a record-setting crowd.
Although the Lionesses triumphed over Germany to claim the Euros in 2022, they have been defeated in the other six matches they played against Germany during the tournament.
As the reigning champions, the Lionesses entered Euro 2025 and were also the finalists in the World Cup 2023.
